job.title: Planning Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

Clarity Partners is looking for an experienced Planning Engineer to join a global-scale gold producer with major operations across Western Australia and Alaska, focused on the organic growth of its high-quality assets, extending mine lives and maximising operational efficiencies.

About You

  • Tertiary qualification in Mining Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience in mine planning, design and production scheduling.
  • Strong working knowledge of Deswik CAD and Deswik IS or similar mine planning software.
